title: A systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of the effect of protein supplementation on resistance training-induced gains in muscle mass and strength in healthy adults
authors: Morton RW, Murphy KT, McKellar SR, Schoenfeld BJ, Henselmans M, Helms E, Aragon AA, Devries MC, Banfield L, Krieger JW, Phillips SM
note: 49 RCTs, 1863 participants; mostly young untrained men; break point analysis not statistically significant (p=0.079)

title: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: protein and exercise
authors: Jäger R, Kerksick CM, Campbell BI, Cribb PJ, Wells SD, Skwiat TM, Purpura M, Ziegenfuss TN, Ferrando AA, Arent SM, Smith-Ryan AE, Stout JR, Arciero PJ, Ormsbee MJ, Taylor LW, Wilborn CD, Kalman DS, Kreider RB, Willoughby DS, Hoffman JR, Krzykowski JL, Antonio J
note: Newest ISSN protein position stand found (searched ISSN position stands 2023-2026). ISSN is a society with supplement-industry ties; read alongside ACSM/AND/DC 2016.

title: The anabolic response to protein ingestion during recovery from exercise has no upper limit in magnitude and duration in vivo in humans
authors: Trommelen J, van Lieshout GAA, Nyakayiru J, Holwerda AM, Smeets JSJ, Hendriks FK, van Kranenburg JMX, Zorenc AH, Senden JM, Goessens JPB, Gijsen AP, van Loon LJC

title: Evidence-based recommendations for optimal dietary protein intake in older people: a position paper from the PROT-AGE Study Group
authors: Bauer J, Biolo G, Cederholm T, Cesari M, Cruz-Jentoft AJ, Morley JE, Phillips S, Sieber C, Stehle P, Teta D, Visvanathan R, Volpi E, Boirie Y
note: More than 10 years old; abstract only. ESPEN Expert Group (Deutz 2014, Clin Nutr, PMC4208946) gives the same 1.0-1.2 g/kg/day for healthy over-65s.

title: American College of Sports Medicine Joint Position Statement. Nutrition and Athletic Performance
authors: Thomas DT, Erdman KA, Burke LM
note: Joint position of ACSM, Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics and Dietitians of Canada, published concurrently in J Acad Nutr Diet (PMID 26920240). Full text taken from the Dietitians of Canada PDF of the same joint paper (Feb 2016, revised Dec 2016). No newer joint position found (searched 2020-2026); a UCI cycling nutrition position statement (2026, PMID 42744290) exists but its full text was not accessible.

title: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: nutritional considerations for single-stage ultra-marathon training and racing
authors: Tiller NB, Roberts JD, Beasley L, Chapman S, Pinto JM, Smith L, Wiffin M, Russell M, Sparks SA, Duckworth L, O'Hara J, Sutton L, Antonio J, Willoughby DS, Tarpey MD, Smith-Ryan AE, Ormsbee MJ, Astorino TA, Kreider RB, McGinnis GR, Stout JR, Smith JW, Arent SM, Campbell BI, Bannock L
note: Evidence base for ultra-specific numbers is mostly observational field studies of race intake

title: Training the Gut for Athletes
authors: Jeukendrup AE
note: Narrative review; parts extrapolated from animal data; author has sports-nutrition industry links

authors: American College of Sports Medicine, Sawka MN, Burke LM, Eichner ER, Maughan RJ, Montain SJ, Stachenfeld NS
note: More than 10 years old; no newer ACSM fluid position stand found. Abstract only. NATA 2017 (McDermott2017) is the newer position statement used alongside it.

title: National Athletic Trainers' Association Position Statement: Fluid Replacement for the Physically Active
authors: McDermott BP, Anderson SA, Armstrong LE, Casa DJ, Cheuvront SN, Cooper L, Kenney WL, O'Connor FG, Roberts WO
note: Full text saved from the PMC HTML page

title: Impact of Ad Libitum Versus Programmed Drinking on Endurance Performance: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
authors: Goulet EDB, Hoffman MD
note: Small: 7 publications, 8 effect estimates, 82 subjects; exercise 1-2 h; abstract only

title: 2023 International Olympic Committee's (IOC) consensus statement on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs)
authors: Mountjoy M, Ackerman KE, Bailey DM, Burke LM, Constantini N, Hackney AC, Heikura IA, Melin A, Pensgaard AM, Stellingwerff T, Sundgot-Borgen JK, Torstveit MK, Jacobsen AU, Verhagen E, Budgett R, Engebretsen L, Erdener U

title: International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: diets for body weight reduction
authors: Aragon AA, Campbell BI, Schoenfeld BJ, Stout JR, Kalman D, Arciero PJ, Arent SM, Kreider RB, Taylor LW, Bannock L, Wildman REC, Kerksick CM, Antonio J
note: Newest ISSN stand on weight-loss diets; adults who are healthy, active or athletic; excludes dehydration-based weight cutting and GLP-1 drugs. Discusses Garthe 2011 (slow vs fast weight loss RCT) and Helms 2014.

title: Overweight and obesity management (NICE guideline NG246)
authors: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
note: Published 14 January 2025, last updated 2026; replaces CG189 (2014) and PH53. UK clinical guideline for people living with overweight or obesity, not for athletes.

title: IOC consensus statement: dietary supplements and the high-performance athlete
authors: Maughan RJ, Burke LM, Dvorak J, Larson-Meyer DE, Peeling P, Phillips SM, Rawson ES, Walsh NP, Garthe I, Geyer H, Meeusen R, van Loon LJC, Shirreffs SM, Spriet LL, Stuart M, Vernec A, Currell K, Ali VM, Budgett RG, Ljungqvist A, Mountjoy M, Pitsiladis YP, Soligard T, Erdener U, Engebretsen L
